source_refs.note: Book p. 10: 1.5.1 table of the six hyperbolic functions (definition, domain, range), hyperbola remark, Example 9

blocks.text: Pichle page par humne sirf naam suna tha; ab hum in functions se baqaida mulaqat karte hain. Sab se pehle kitab ek table deti hai jis mein chhe (6) hyperbolic functions, un ki definition, domain (woh values jo \(x\) le sakta hai) aur range (woh values jo function de sakta hai) likhi hain. Is table ko ratta nahin lagana, samajhna hai; neeche hum dekhenge ke har cheez kahan se aati hai.
Kitab ke mutabiq hyperbolic functions is tarah define kiye jate hain:

blocks.caption: The six hyperbolic functions: definition, domain and range

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Is table ko kaise parhein:
1. Asal mein sirf do functions naye hain: \(\sinh x\) aur \(\cosh x\). Baqi chaar bilkul trigonometry ki tarah inhi se bante hain: \(\tanh = \sinh/\cosh\), \(\coth = \cosh/\sinh\), \(\operatorname{sech} = 1/\cosh\), \(\operatorname{csch} = 1/\sinh\). Agar aap ko \(\tan = \sin/\cos\) yaad hai to yeh bhi yaad ho jayega.
2. Domain: \(e^{x}\) aur \(e^{-x}\) har real \(x\) ke liye mojood hain, is liye \(\sinh\) aur \(\cosh\) ka domain \(\mathbb{R}\) hai. \(\cosh x\) kabhi zero nahin hota (do positive numbers ka jama hai), is liye \(\tanh\) aur \(\operatorname{sech}\) ka domain bhi \(\mathbb{R}\) hai. Lekin \(\sinh x = 0\) tab hota hai jab \(e^{x} = e^{-x}\), yani sirf \(x = 0\) par. \(\coth\) aur \(\operatorname{csch}\) mein \(\sinh x\) se divide hota hai, aur zero se divide mana hai, is liye in ka domain \(\mathbb{R}\setminus\{0\}\) (zero ke ilawa saare real numbers) hai.
3. Range: agle page par hum dekhenge ke \(\cosh x \ge 1\). To \(\operatorname{sech} x = 1/\cosh x\) hamesha 0 aur 1 ke darmiyan rahega, yani \((0, 1]\). \(\tanh x\) mein upar wala hissa (numerator) size mein hamesha neeche wale (denominator) se chhota hota hai, is liye \(-1 < \tanh x < 1\). Isi ko ulta karein to \(\coth\) ka size hamesha 1 se bara: \(|\coth x| > 1\).
Kitab batati hai ke in functions ka naam "hyperbolic" is liye hai ke parametric equations \(x = \cosh t\) aur \(y = \sinh t\) hyperbola ki equation \(x^{2} - y^{2} = 1\) ko satisfy karti hain.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Trigonometry se muqabla kijiye: \(x = \cos t\), \(y = \sin t\) rakhein to \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 1\) (circle) banta hai, kyun ke \(\cos^{2} t + \sin^{2} t = 1\). Yahan \(x = \cosh t\), \(y = \sinh t\) rakhein to \(x^{2} - y^{2} = \cosh^{2} t - \sinh^{2} t\) banta hai, aur Example 9 dikhata hai ke yeh hamesha 1 hai. Is liye point \((\cosh t, \sinh t)\) hamesha hyperbola \(x^{2} - y^{2} = 1\) par rehta hai (us ki daayen shaakh (right branch) par, kyun ke \(\cosh t \ge 1\)). Circle se "circular" functions, hyperbola se "hyperbolic" functions: naam ki kahani itni si hai.
Ab kitab ki misaal dekhte hain jo yahi baat saabit karti hai. Is mein sirf do cheezein chahiye: definitions aur \((a \pm b)^{2}\) ka formula.

blocks.title: Example 9
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\cosh x = \frac{e^{x}+e^{-x}}{2}\) aur \(\sinh x = \frac{e^{x}-e^{-x}}{2}\).
Maloom karna (prove karna): \(\cosh^{2} x - \sinh^{2} x = 1\).
Tareeqa: identity saabit karne ka seedha usool yeh hai ke ek side (aam taur par mushkil wali, yahan left side) se shuru karein aur use simplify karte jayein, yahan tak ke doosri side ban jaye. Hum left side mein definitions rakhenge, squares ko \((a \pm b)^{2} = a^{2} \pm 2ab + b^{2}\) se kholenge, aur yeh yaad rakhenge ke \(e^{x} \cdot e^{-x} = 1\).

Qadam 1: Definitions rakhiye
\[\cosh^{2} x - \sinh^{2} x\]
\[= \left(\dfrac{e^{x}+e^{-x}}{2}\right)^{2} - \left(\dfrac{e^{x}-e^{-x}}{2}\right)^{2}\]
Kyun: \(\cosh^{2} x\) ka matlab \((\cosh x)^{2}\) hai, is liye poori fraction ka square hoga, sirf upar wale hisse ka nahin. Neeche wala 2 bhi square ho kar 4 banega.

Qadam 2: Pehla square kholiye
\[(e^{x}+e^{-x})^{2} = e^{2x} + 2e^{x}e^{-x} + e^{-2x}\]
\[= e^{2x} + e^{-2x} + 2\]
Kyun: \((a+b)^{2} = a^{2} + 2ab + b^{2}\) ka formula laga. \((e^{x})^{2} = e^{2x}\) (powers multiply hoti hain), aur beech wala term \(2e^{x}e^{-x} = 2e^{x-x} = 2e^{0} = 2\). Yahi woh jaadu hai jis se \(x\) gayab hota hai.

Qadam 3: Doosra square kholiye
\[(e^{x}-e^{-x})^{2} = e^{2x} - 2 + e^{-2x}\]
Kyun: \((a-b)^{2} = a^{2} - 2ab + b^{2}\); beech wala term ab \(-2\) hai. Dono squares mein sirf beech wale term ka sign alag hai, aur poora khel isi farq ka hai.

Qadam 4: Common denominator 4 par tafreeq (subtract) kijiye
\[= \left(\dfrac{e^{2x}+e^{-2x}+2}{4}\right) - \left(\dfrac{e^{2x}+e^{-2x}-2}{4}\right)\]
\[= \dfrac{e^{2x}+e^{-2x}+2-e^{2x}-e^{-2x}+2}{4}\]
Kyun: doosre bracket ke aage minus hai, to bracket kholte waqt andar ke har term ka sign badal jata hai: \(+e^{2x}\) ban gaya \(-e^{2x}\), aur \(-2\) ban gaya \(+2\).
Dhyan dein: yahin sab se zyada ghalti hoti hai; bohat se students sirf pehle term ka sign badalte hain aur \(-2\) ko \(-2\) hi rehne dete hain, phir jawab 0 aa jata hai.

Qadam 5: Simplify kijiye
\[= \dfrac{4}{4} = 1\]
Kyun: \(e^{2x}\) aur \(-e^{2x}\) cancel ho gaye, \(e^{-2x}\) aur \(-e^{-2x}\) bhi cancel ho gaye. Bacha sirf \(2 + 2 = 4\), aur \(4/4 = 1\). Is tarah \(\cosh^{2} x - \sinh^{2} x = 1\) saabit ho gaya.

Tasdeeq: \(x = 1\) le kar dekhiye: \(\cosh 1 \approx 1.5431\), \(\sinh 1 \approx 1.1752\).
\[1.5431^{2} - 1.1752^{2}\]
\[\approx 2.3811 - 1.3811 = 1\]
Kyun: kisi bhi \(x\) par yeh farq 1 hi aata hai; yahi identity ka matlab hai. Aap \(x = 2\) le kar bhi khud check kar sakte hain.
blocks.answer: \(\cosh^{2} x - \sinh^{2} x = 1\) (saabit ho gaya). Yeh \(\cos^{2} x + \sin^{2} x = 1\) ka hyperbolic jora (partner) hai, bas yahan plus ki jagah minus hai.

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text:
Example 9 is section ki sab se zyada istemal hone wali identity hai. Sign ka farq zehan mein bitha lijiye:
\[\cos^{2} x + \sin^{2} x = 1\]
\[\cosh^{2} x - \sinh^{2} x = 1\]
Is identity ko \(\cosh^{2} x\) ya \(\sinh^{2} x\) se divide karein to Exercise 1.2 ke Question 7 wali identities nikal aati hain. Paper mein yeh aksar aati hain.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Table mein \(\tanh x\) ki range \((-1, 1)\) hai. Kya \(\tanh x\) kabhi bilkul 1 ban sakta hai? Socha? Iske liye \(e^{x} - e^{-x} = e^{x} + e^{-x}\) hona chahiye, yani \(e^{-x} = 0\), jo kabhi nahin hota. Is liye 1 range mein shamil nahin, sirf us ke qareeb jata hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
(Yeh hamari taraf se hai, kitab ki nahin.) \(x = \ln 2\) lijiye. Phir \(e^{x} = 2\) aur \(e^{-x} = \frac{1}{2}\).
\(\sinh(\ln 2) = \frac{2 - 1/2}{2} = \frac{3}{4}\), \(\cosh(\ln 2) = \frac{2 + 1/2}{2} = \frac{5}{4}\).
Ab check kijiye: \(\left(\frac{5}{4}\right)^{2} - \left(\frac{3}{4}\right)^{2} = \frac{25 - 9}{16} = 1\). Bilkul Example 9 ke mutabiq! Aur \(\tanh(\ln 2) = \frac{3/4}{5/4} = \frac{3}{5}\), jo \(-1\) aur 1 ke darmiyan hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \(\sinh x = \frac{e^{x}-e^{-x}}{2}\), \(\cosh x = \frac{e^{x}+e^{-x}}{2}\); baqi chaar inhi do se bante hain.
2. \(\sinh\), \(\cosh\), \(\tanh\), \(\operatorname{sech}\) ka domain \(\mathbb{R}\); \(\coth\), \(\operatorname{csch}\) ka domain \(\mathbb{R}\setminus\{0\}\).
3. Ranges: \(\sinh\): \(\mathbb{R}\); \(\cosh\): \([1, \infty)\); \(\tanh\): \((-1, 1)\); \(\coth\): \((-\infty, -1)\cup(1, \infty)\); \(\operatorname{sech}\): \((0, 1]\); \(\operatorname{csch}\): \(\mathbb{R}\setminus\{0\}\).
4. \(\cosh^{2} x - \sinh^{2} x = 1\), is liye \((\cosh t, \sinh t)\) hyperbola \(x^{2} - y^{2} = 1\) par hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Trigonometry ki identity copy kar ke \(\cosh^{2} x + \sinh^{2} x = 1\) likh dena: hyperbolic identity mein minus hai.
2. Signs mein uljhan: \(\sinh\) mein minus (\(e^{x} - e^{-x}\)), \(\cosh\) mein plus (\(e^{x} + e^{-x}\)). Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: "cosh = jama, sinh = farq".
3. Bhool jana ke \(\coth x\) aur \(\operatorname{csch} x\) \(x = 0\) par define nahin.
4. Sirf numerator ka square karna: \(\left(\frac{e^{x}+e^{-x}}{2}\right)^{2}\) mein neeche 4 aata hai, 2 nahin.
